messages.subject: shiny application - selection of dataset or multiple datasets?
parts:
Hi all,

I have been using R  to make tree maps based on a file which contains countries and years. I make a tree map for each combination of country and year. Now, I would like to make this interactive using the Shiny package. What I would like is for people to choose one or multiple countries AND one or multiple time points and then provide the tree maps for these countries and time points.

I have been trough the tutorial and checked out some other examples and I have two design questions. Most examples, where data selection is reactive, there is not one big dataset, but multiple smaller datasets. Should I therefore make different datasets for each country and period, or is it possible to have users select parts of the data (countries/time periods)?

How would I order the display of multiple images? Is there someway to define a grid?

Best wishes,

Richard
